title: Actuator overshoot
statement: Given the spring-loaded leg stores 4 J, there is a possibility the release latch fails open, resulting in uncontrolled motion near operators.
mitigation: Interlocked guard + e-stop (DEMO-SYS-002) + latch proof test
trigger: Guard interlock fault or latch test failure

title: Offload rig fidelity
statement: Given the cable offload rig adds friction, there is a possibility measured hop height differs from the analogue target, resulting in invalid locomotion conclusions.
mitigation: Characterise rig friction with calibration masses before trials

title: Sensor lead time
statement: Given a single supplier for the displacement sensor, there is a possibility of delivery slip, resulting in a 3-week schedule delay.
